Shadow roots and frames

Every case below starts with its name. The tests read which of them a rendered scan calls hidden.

CASE-SLOTTED-VISIBLE is slotted where it shows.

CASE-SLOTTED-INTO-HIDDEN is slotted into a part of the shadow root that is display:none.

CASE-UNSLOTTED is a child of the host that no slot takes, so it never renders.

CASE-PAGE-VISIBLE closes the page.
